description: Comprehensive training dataset for AI Video Generation, Motion Synthesis, AnimateDiff, Sora, Kling, Runway Gen-2/Gen-3, and Lip Sync

training_data.prompt: Cinematic slow-motion shot of a futuristic drone navigating through a foggy pine forest at sunrise, 4k 60fps

completion.negative_prompt: choppy movement, flickering, morphing limbs, static camera, noise artifacts, frame dropping

training_data.prompt: Animate a static image of water cascading down a mountain waterfall with realistic mist effect
Explain camera movement parameters for high-end cinematic video generation

camera_moves.dolly_zoom: simultaneous zoom in and backward movement for vertigo effect
camera_moves.orbit_around: 360-degree smooth rotational camera sweep around target subject
camera_moves.crane_up: vertical elevation shot exposing wide landscape

training_data.prompt: How to configure audio-driven avatar lip sync for video generation using SadTalker or Wav2Lip
Workflow for taking a 512x512 low fps video and upscaling it to 4K 60fps smooth video

steps: Step 1: Frame interpolation using RIFE / Real-CSI to increase framerate from 15fps to 60fps
Step 2: Spatial AI upscaling using Real-ESRGAN / SeedVR to 4K resolution
Step 3: Temporal smoothing filter to eliminate inter-frame flicker
Step 4: H.265 / AV1 encoding with CRF 18
